title: Austin's Food Policy & Financial Look
summary:
*   City officials reviewed proposed agenda items for an upcoming meeting to plan future discussions and decisions.
*   A presentation was held to discuss the city's Year-End Financial Report, detailing its fiscal health.
*   A proposed discussion regarding the establishment of a Food Policy Council was postponed to a later date.
